name: Thiobuscaline
summary: Thiobuscaline (TB), or 4-thiobuscaline (4-TB), also known as 3,5-dimethoxy-4-butylthiophenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to the psychedelic drug mescaline. It is the analogue of buscaline in which the butoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a butylthio group.

pharmacology.text: Thiobuscaline shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 602 nM). It is a potent near-full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors and to a much lesser extent a moderate-efficacy partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, with EC50 (Emax) values of 3.86 nM (114%) at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, 89.6 nM (55.7%) at the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and 8.86 nM (95.9%) at the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptor agonist; Psychoactive drug; Antidepressant

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是一種罕見的研究用化學品，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种罕见的研究用化学品，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of this type can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, and a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in people who are vulnerable.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類迷幻藥可能造成噁心、焦慮、意識混亂、心跳與血壓上升，並可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持續的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类迷幻药可能造成恶心、焦虑、意识混乱、心跳与血压上升，并可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持续的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is buscaline with the oxygen atom of its butoxy group replaced by sulphur. Alexander Shulgin explored a whole series of such sulphur-swapped relatives of mescaline.
fact.zh: 它是把buscaline丁氧基中的氧原子換成硫原子的產物。亞歷山大．舒爾金曾探索過一整系列這類以硫取代的麥司卡林近親。
fact.zhHans: 它是把buscaline丁氧基中的氧原子换成硫原子的产物。亚历山大．舒尔金曾探索过一整系列这类以硫取代的麦司卡林近亲。
